<h1 className={"openapi__heading"}>Get a list of all tracing accounts</h1>

<MethodEndpoint method={"get"} path={"/v1/account-management/consumption/tracing-accounts"}></MethodEndpoint>



Returns all tracing accounts of a **Consumption** owner account.
Available for **Consumption** accounts only. If the account is not a Consumption account, the request returns `400`.

Please ensure to change the region in the URL to match your account's region.
